channel.title: The Grant Desk - Design & Games, Switzerland, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Design & Games, Switzerland, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
3 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 20 Jul 2026 (20 Jul to 26 Jul 2026).

  • Game Design Emerging Talents: Production
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 50,000, requiring a matching grant of equal value from own or third-party funding. No application fee.

    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 20,000, plus potential individual coaching. No application fee.
